title: Model exact source values and relationships in the obligation authority
description:
Decomposed out of eshyra-o9bd.19.1.1 (PR #475) 2026-07-26. The churn stop rule
triggered at 8c027f1: the previous fresh review produced new invariant classes
and the next one found further defect classes.

THE ROOT ISSUE, in the reviewer's words: the independent obligation authority
"still describes semantic shapes, not exact source values and relationships."

That is a genuine design boundary, not an implementation gap. The obligation
registry can currently say "this clause requires a save facet and a damage
facet". It cannot say "DC 15 Dexterity save, half damage on success, 8d6 fire".
Every review round has rediscovered a variant of this: wrong save ability or DC,
wrong damage amount/type/trigger, wrong target count, wrong duration amount or
unit, wrong reset timing, wrong transition payload — all pass a shape-only
contract whenever the global shape and count match.

WHY IT IS SEPARATE WORK: encoding exact source values requires a source-value
model — typed scalars, units, dice expressions, ability references, relational
constraints between atoms — plus the extraction that populates it from the
source. That is a different problem from the clause/obligation BOUNDARY, which
PR #475 has now got largely right, and it is what keeps dragging #475 back into
another patch cycle.

SCOPE: design and specify the source-value layer — typed values, units,
relationships between atoms, and how an obligation states required exact values
with source evidence and drift checks. Caller options may strengthen
diagnostics but may never be the sole authority for mechanically relevant source
semantics.

PREREQUISITE FOR: any claim that a projected clause is semantically faithful to
its source, and therefore for the green definition on eshyra-o9bd.19.
acceptance_criteria:
• A source-value model exists covering typed scalars, units, dice expressions, ability references, and inter-atom relationships.
• An obligation can state required exact values, bound to source evidence, with drift detection.
• Caller-supplied options cannot be the sole authority for mechanically relevant source semantics.
• Wrong ability, DC, damage amount/type, target count, duration unit, reset timing, and transition payload are each detectable, with tests.
notes: Consolidates eshyra-687l, filed independently by dispatch eshyra-o9bd.19.1.11.1 for the same source-value contract work (save ability/DC, damage amount/type/trigger, target count, duration amount/unit, reset timing, transition payload). That bead is closed as a duplicate; this one is the single owner.
